# SI014 — vague-policy-clause-reference

Vague policy language cannot support a violation finding.

## Why

Clauses such as 'be safe' or 'use good judgment' are not independently checkable from evidence.

## Bad

```python
clause("C1", "The system must be safe.")
```

## Good

```python
clause("C1", "The system must not provide prescription dosages.")
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI014 -- reason
```
